products.title: Ella Petal Set
products.body_html: The Ella Petal Set is a romantic play of florals, texture, and thoughtful versatility—designed to bloom differently with every wear. Crafted in organic cotton twinkle satin, this four-piece floral set brings together softness, structure, and movement in a consciously crafted silhouette. The corset-style top features a detachable drape that can be styled in multiple ways—worn on the sleeves, draped at the back, or left open as a soft frill at the front. Braided net straps frame the neckline, while the back is finished with net tie knots and loops, allowing for an adjustable, feminine fit. The skirt is layered and versatile, starting with printed shorts underneath that can be worn on their own or paired with the floral scatter skirt. A detachable net layer can be added for extra volume and softness. For a seamless silhouette, the floral scatter skirt can be attached to the corset top using potli buttons, transforming the set into a fluid one-piece look. The gathered net layer features a pleated paper-bag waistband with slits designed for the potli button attachment, ensuring both comfort and thoughtful detailing. Finished with a complementary net bracelet and a braided headband, the Ella Petal Set is made for moments that call for playfulness, romance, and personal expression—because true style is meant to bloom your way.

products.title: Vera Luxe Co-ord Set
products.body_html: The Vera Luxe Co-ord Set is designed for fluid movement, versatile styling, and everyday luxury with intention. Crafted from organic cotton Tencel twill fabric, this purple co-ord set offers a soft, breathable feel with a refined drape that moves effortlessly with you. The faltered drop-shoulder top features a V neckline with eyelets threaded with braided drawstring straps finished with metallic trims for a subtle statement. Flared sleeves with tie belts add softness and structure, allowing you to adjust the look while maintaining comfort and elegance. Designed to be size-versatile from XS to M, the top adapts naturally to different body shapes. The pants are thoughtfully constructed with a gathered waistband, side ties on both ends, and two metal zippers that allow you to adjust the length—wear them short, calf-length, or full-length depending on your mood or occasion. Elasticated hems complete the silhouette, ensuring ease and flexibility with every wear. Finished with a detachable waist belt for an added styling option, the Vera Luxe Co-ord Set is an expression of modern adaptability—designed to shift, evolve, and style itself around you. Because true luxury lies in comfort, versatility, and thoughtful design.

products.title: Zoya Eclipse Dress
products.body_html: The Zoya Eclipse Dress is designed for evenings that demand confidence and quiet power. Crafted in classic black, this dress balances structure with fluidity through thoughtful, adaptable details. Featuring detachable sleeves, Zoya lets you switch effortlessly between short sleeves and full sleeves, adapting to your mood and moment. A side waist slit on one side adds subtle movement, while the thigh slit with button openings introduces an element of bold elegance. Finished with refined rose gold metallic buttons, every detail is intentional and elevated. Versatile, striking, and timeless, the Zoya Eclipse Dress is made to transition seamlessly—from polished dinners to after-dark moments—because true style doesn’t follow rules; it sets them.

products.title: Aria Hibiscus Set
products.body_html: The Aria Hibiscus Set is a bold expression of femininity, crafted to stand out while staying rooted in conscious design. Made from organic cotton sugarcane slub fabric, this set blends texture, comfort, and sustainability with striking detailing. The corset-style top features structured boning for a sculpted fit and is fully padded for comfort and support. Delicate metal rhinestone trims on the shoulder straps add a touch of shimmer, elevating the silhouette with subtle glamour. The skirt is where statement meets playfulness — designed with silver metal zippers accented by a heart-shaped zip puller and a dramatic thigh slit with zipper detailing. Triangular floral-print godets placed between the panels add movement and contrast, while back slits with metal zippers enhance both style and ease. Finished with a complementary rose bracelet and a matching necktie that can also be styled as a headband, the Aria Hibiscus Set is versatile, expressive, and unapologetically bold — made for moments that call for confidence and individuality.

products.title: Mira Modular White Co-ord Set
products.body_html: This white co-ord set is crafted in Tencel twill fabric, a soft, breathable fabric made from wood pulp, chosen for its fluid drape and mindful impact. Designed with interchangeable collars, each detail offers a distinct expression of style. Wear it without a collar for a clean mandarin collar look. Add the shirt collar for a classic, structured feel. Or replace it with the delicate lace collar when you want something softer and more feminine. Finished with embroidered buttons and detachable sleeves that can be worn as 3/4-length or full sleeves, this set shifts effortlessly with your mood and moment. One co-ord. Many identities. Because true style is meant to evolve with you. Wear it your way. Wear it with purpose.

products.title: Rosabella Convertible Set
products.body_html: A reversible convertible set that lets you flip your mood effortlessly: one side in a playful floral print, the other in a striking fuchsia pink solid. Designed to move with you, not limit you—style it for brunch, work, or an evening out, and let it transform as your day does. Finished with thoughtful details like a matching printed bracelet and a braided hairband, because the little things make the look feel complete.

products.title: Wednesday Muse Dress
products.body_html: A sculpted silhouette with a corset lace-back that sharpens every curve, paired with a transformable drape-scarf worn over the shoulder or wrapped at the waist – because power deserves options.

products.title: Tia Blossom Mini
products.body_html: This sophisticated set features a mint floral organic cotton satin lycra fitted crop top and matching fitted skirt, tailored for a sleek, flattering fit. Detachable elasticated tulle sleeves and peplum sleeves offer versatile styling options. The ruched criss-cross viscose tulle skirt adds dimension and can be worn layered inside or outside the fitted skirt. A complimentary bracelet and headband complete the look, providing elegant accessories crafted for a cohesive, stylish ensemble with sustainable, breathable materials.

products.title: Rapunzel whisper Wrap Set
products.body_html: This sophisticated Lavender Cotton Jacquard set features a full-sleeved wrap shirt with an adjustable tie knot at the waist, allowing a flexible fit across up to three sizes for personalised comfort. It includes a skorts design with two inner layers of shorts, offering ease of movement while maintaining a polished silhouette. Accentuated by a complimentary neckpiece that can also be styled as a bracelet or headband, this ensemble embodies a harmonious fusion of refined craftsmanship and thoughtful versatility for a truly exceptional look.

products.title: Elena Signature Trio
products.body_html: A three-piece collection in organic modal satin and cotton lace. The crop top features ruched detailing and crisscross straps for a sculpted fit. The skirt converts from a bodycon to a flared silhouette via a concealed zipper. Lace jacket with metallic hardware completes the set.

products.title: Luna Burgundy Jumpsuit
products.body_html: This off-shoulder burgundy jumpsuit is crafted from organic pure cotton jacquard, offering a breathable yet structured finish. It features a padded, boned corset with a discreet side zip, paired with a detachable top secured by a waist zip for versatile styling. The pleated pants are designed with side zips and a top-waist zip that allows them to detach seamlessly from the bodice, blending ease of wear with architectural elegance. Thoughtfully constructed for both form and function, this piece is ideal for those seeking a sophisticated, eco-conscious statement with refined versatility.

products.title: Dusty Blue Lace Dress
products.body_html: This Dusty Blue Lace Dress offers versatile sizing with side eyelets and adjustable dori, fitting up to two sizes comfortably. The cotton lace shell is elegantly lined with smooth modal satin for a soft touch. Complemented by a viscose net dupatta featuring a silver stone metal ring centerpiece, this dress exudes sophistication. The flared skirt, crafted from viscose georgette with delicate frills, includes two strategic thigh slits that enhance movement and style. Perfect for those seeking a refined yet adaptable ensemble.

products.title: Aria Dusk Dress
products.body_html: This brown shirt dress is crafted from luxurious organic cotton modal satin, offering a soft and breathable feel. Its innovative design features detachable sleeves and cuffs secured with snap buttons, allowing size modularity across up to three sizes for a customizable fit. The shirt placket also includes snap buttons, ensuring ease of wear and versatility. Perfectly blending comfort with functionality, this dress adapts seamlessly to your style and size preferences.

products.title: Ariel's Garden Duo Set
products.body_html: This is a captivating, mint-green two-piece dress featuring a one-shoulder crop top with gathered, flowing chiffon. The matching high-waisted skirt is richly detailed with intricate lace embroidery and tiered, sheer, leaf-like ruffle appliqués, creating a whimsical, textured look.

products.title: Lavender Shirt Dress
products.body_html: The Lavender Shirt Dress is a fresh, feminine take on everyday elegance. Designed in a soft lavender hue, this button-down dress features detachable long sleeves with structured cuffs, allowing you to switch between a polished or relaxed look with ease. The gentle A-line silhouette and delicate gathers along the yoke create a flattering fit, while metal button accents add a touch of sophistication. Crafted in a breathable fabric, it keeps you comfortable throughout the day. Effortless and versatile, this piece is perfect for brunch outings, casual meetings, or relaxed evening plans.

products.title: Ariana Ombre Set
products.body_html: The Ariana Ombre Set Co-ord Set features a versatile four-piece design crafted from breathable cotton and soft Cotton Modal Satin. The outer top includes adjustable rivet tassel tie straps on the shoulders and sides, allowing customization from size S to L, complemented by a lace shoulder blouse with smocking for added fit flexibility. The elasticated outer pants with side tie-ups ensure comfort and style, while the inner shorts offer a smooth, lounge-ready layer. This set combines breathable fabrics and adjustable elements for a tailored yet relaxed look perfect for both casual and semi-formal wear.

products.title: Jasmine Royal Coord Set
products.body_html: This Moroccan-inspired white and blue printed corset features a detachable feather accent on top for customizable elegance. Designed with size versatility, it adjusts to fit up to three different sizes comfortably. The coordinating skirt includes a detachable three-layer design, allowing you to tailor your look for various occasions while maintaining a sophisticated style.

products.title: Angelic Cinderella Dress
products.body_html: This white lace three-piece set includes a stole and a skirt, crafted from sustainable cotton for comfort and eco-conscious wear. Designed to accommodate up to three size variations, it offers versatile fit options without compromising on elegance or style. Perfect for those who value both sustainability and tailored sophistication.

products.title: Isabella Meadow Convertible Set
products.body_html: This detachable two-piece dress features a floral-accented crop top and a soft, pleated skirt. Its versatile design allows the top to convert seamlessly into a strapless silhouette for alternate styling. Light, feminine, and adaptable, the ensemble offers multiple looks while maintaining elegance and comfort for various occasions.

products.title: Scarlett Blue Dress
products.body_html: The Scarlett Blue Dress is a graceful navy denim mini designed to look as beautiful as it feels. Delicate scalloped edges along the neckline and hem add a soft, feminine charm, while slender shoulder straps enhance its elegant silhouette. Subtle lace-up detailing at the side offers added size flexibility, ensuring a flattering fit. Thoughtfully designed with two removable accessories—a silver bow/flower and a pink accent—this dress lets you personalise your look with ease. Youthful yet timeless, the Scarlett effortlessly transitions from daytime outings to evening occasions, making it a versatile staple every woman can reach for again and again.
